power.neoorigins.wraith_hunger_drain.des: Aḥraz n tfekka-k d taẓeyt  tesseččaḍ laẓ s 75% s zzerb ɣef tannumi.
power.neoorigins.wraith_evolved_phase.de: Rmed/Sens: lḥu deg yiḥedran s tafergact deg usekḥer. Asekḥer n laẓ ad yeqṣer s 25%. Obsidian akked uẓru n uẓar mazal-iten sewḥalen-k.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_weaknes: Iɛdawen iqerben deg 3 n yiḥedran ttwaḍnen s leǧruḥ.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_dayligh: Aḥulfu i tafat n yiṭij yettfakka
Tafat n yiṭij mazal-itt tesserɣay, maca s uzgen seg tezɣelt-is.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.name: Talɣa n usfaylu (Apex)
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.descr: Rmed/Sens: lḥu deg yiḥedran merra anagar ablaḍ n uẓru s ufeggag deg usekḥer. Aẓar meẓẓi maḍi. Ulac d acu ara k-id-iḥebsen.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_hunger_drai: Talɣa-k n tmuɣli teṣṣebber  laẓ yettruḥ kan s 25% s zzerb ɣef tannumi.
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.name: Askeleton
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.description: Tacekkaṛt n yiɣsan i d-yettasen ɣer tudert  d taruradt, d tafessast, d tamettant s uẓeṭṭa. Amasal-nni d afessas, ur t-yettaǧǧa ara yiṭij, ur yezmir ad yečč ala tiẓidanin-nni yexṣen maḍi.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.name: Undead
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.descrip: Ur temmuteḍ ara. Isekkilen n ddwa ttḍurrun-k, isekkilen n ddwa ttḍurrun-k, ma d isekkilen n Smite ttḍurrun-k ugar.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_water_breathin: Ur yeḥwaǧ ara ad yesnuffes. Yezmer ad yidir i lebda ddaw waman.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_marksmanship.d: +2 n wuguren n uzegrir s yimrigen.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.name: Tafat n yiɣes
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.descript: D iɣsan-ik iɣuren i k-yettaǧǧan tzerbeḍ s 20% deg uḍar.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.name: Fessus
Iɣsan-ik imerẓiyen ssenqesent tazmert-ik afellay ɣer 7 n wulawen.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_daylight_damag: Tesserɣayeḍ i yiṭij srid, ala ma telsiḍ amḍelliw.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.name: Aɣṛum war iɣsan
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.descripti: Tzemreḍ kan ad teččeḍ tiremt n yiɣsan, aksum yeqquren d wallen n tissist.
D lmakla n yiɣsan i tettetteḍ.
origins.neoorigins.slime.name: Slime
origins.neoorigins.slime.description: D amdan am jellat i ilaqen ad yeqqim yesɛa aman akken ad yidir. Yettneggiz ur yettḍurru, yefreq seg lmut mi ara yečč, yerna yettimɣur s termit.
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.name: Lemleḥ
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.descript: Ɣur-k aferdis n umided i yetteffɣen s waṭas. Itteffɣen s zzerb deg tneẓruft neɣ deg tmes. Qqim deg waman neɣ ageffur akken ad tesneqseḍ. Ugar n 75%: Regen 1. ddaw n 10%: -4 armur. Deg 0%: ad tḍurruḍ.
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.name: Bḍu
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.descri: Mi ara temmteḍ s ugar n 75% n wusu, ad tebḍuḍ deg umḍiq-is  s usiweḍ n 50 n yiḥedran s 2 n wulawen. HP-ik afellay ad d-yuɣal s wudem amagnu deg 2 n tesdatin.
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.name: Timerna n jlatinous
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.descript: +1 HP afellay deg 10 n yiswiren n termit. Ad yettuwennez deg tmettant.
power.neoorigins.slime_no_fall_damage.de: Ur d-tḍurruḍ ara mi ara teɣliḍ  ad tnegreḍ.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_evolved_hp.name: Tazmert n tudert i d-yekkren
power.neoorigins.abyssal_apex_hp.name: Aceɛlal ameqqran
power.neoorigins.abyssal_apex_conduit_po: Tafesna n waman i lebda, tamuɣli deg yiḍ, akked Uɣiwel  deg wakal neɣ ddaw waman.
